purpose: Registro verificable de atlas 3D externos; cada fuente conserva su licencia y su espacio anatómico.

sources.name: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D — atlas masculino detallado
sources.coverage: Cuerpo masculino completo, sistemas por separado
sources.attribution: Z-Anatomy, derived from BodyParts3D (The Database Center for Life Science, DBCLS); adapted meshes distributed by Anatria3D, Nurkan1, under CC BY-SA 4.0. Preserve upstream NOTICE and LICENSE.
sources.status: source_verified; staged separately; not yet activated in the viewer

sources.name: HuBMAP / Human Reference Atlas — órganos femeninos de referencia
sources.coverage: Tronco, abdomen, pelvis, mama, órganos y vasos de referencia; no es un cuerpo femenino completo
sources.attribution: Human Reference Atlas 3D Reference Organ Library, HuBMAP Consortium / NIH, derived from the Visible Human Female dataset of the U.S. National Library of Medicine. CC BY 4.0.
sources.status: source_verified; staged separately; not yet activated in the viewer

sources.name: VOXEL-MAN — Segmented Internal Organs of the Visible Human Male
sources.coverage: Torso desde cuello hasta muslos superiores; más de 200 objetos anatómicos etiquetados
sources.attribution: Segmented Internal Organs of the Visible Human Male dataset by Karl Heinz Höhne, Bernhard Pflesser, Andreas Pommert, Martin Riemer, Thomas Schiemann, Rainer Schubert, Udo Schumacher and Ulf Tiede (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.15882019), VOXEL-MAN project, licensed CC BY 4.0; based on the Visible Human Male of the U.S. National Library of Medicine.
sources.format: TIFF cryosections, CT and 16-bit label volume; not a ready-to-import polygon GLB
sources.status: license_verified; volume source identified; surface extraction and mesh alignment still required
